title: Under BPMN Highlight that users need to add rdbms under the processors in config.json to anonymize data records in the database
body:
**Suggested Labels:**
Type/Docs
Compliance/GDPR
Priority/High

**Affected Product Version:**
EI 6.2.0

**Description**
In [1] Under "BPMN (activiti) component" step 3 please add a note and highlight that if a user wants to anonymize data records in both logs and db tables user need to add the following line
processors" : [
   **"log-file", "rdbms"**
 ],

Even though "rdbms" is mentioned in the given config under step 3 as the default config.json shipped in the pack contain only 
"processors" : [
   "log-file"
 ],
Sometimes users does not get highlighted that they need to add **rdbms** for the config.json if they want to anonymize data in the db table.

[1]. https://docs.wso2.com/display/EI6xx/Removing+Personally+Identifiable+Information
